title: The non-negative coefficient conjecture for the associated Stirling series
statement:
Let $B_r(x)$ denote the function used in the associated Stirling-number asymptotics, and let $r$ be an integer with $r\geq 1$. Consider the power series about $0$ of

$$
e^{-x/(r+1)}B_r(x).
$$

**Non-negative coefficient conjecture.** For each integer $r\geq 1$, this power series has all non-negative coefficients.

If true, this would simplify the proof of the asymptotic expansions for associated Stirling numbers, in particular the proof that $|J|\to 0$. The supplied text gives no resolution of the conjecture.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.01489

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of September 2024).
source_name: E. Rodney Canfield, J. William Helton and Jared A. Hughes, “Uniform Convergence of an Asymptotic Approximation to Associated Stirling Numbers”, arXiv:2409.01489 (2024).
